changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM arr_request_queue_item WHERE request_id IN (SELECT dlr.request_id FROM arr_dao_link_request dlr WHERE dlr.dao_id IN (SELECT d.dao_id FROM arr_dao d JOIN arr_dao_package p ON p.dao_package_id = d.dao_package_id JOIN arr_digital_repository r ON r.external_system_id = p.digital_repository_id WHERE r.digital_repository_type = 'FILESYSTEM')); DELETE FROM arr_dao_link_request WHERE dao_id IN (SELECT d.dao_id FROM arr_dao d JOIN arr_dao_package p ON p.dao_package_id = d.dao_package_id JOIN arr_digital_repository r ON r.external_system_id = p.digital_repository_id WHERE r.digital_repository_type = 'FILESYSTEM'); DELETE FROM arr_request br WHERE br.discriminator = 'DAO_LINK' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM arr_dao_link_request dlr WHERE dlr.request_id = br.request_id); DELETE FROM arr_dao_request_dao WHERE dao_id IN (SELECT d.dao_id FROM arr_dao d JOIN arr_dao_package p ON p.dao_package_id = d.dao_package_id JOIN arr_digital_repository r ON r.external_system_id = p.digital_repository_id WHERE r.digital_repository_type = 'FILESYSTEM'); DELETE FROM arr_dao_file WHERE dao_id IN (SELECT d.dao_id FROM arr_dao d JOIN arr_dao_package p ON p.dao_package_id = d.dao_package_id JOIN arr_digital_repository r ON r.external_system_id = p.digital_repository_id WHERE r.digital_repository_type = 'FILESYSTEM'); DELETE FROM arr_dao WHERE dao_package_id IN (SELECT p.dao_package_id FROM arr_dao_package p JOIN arr_digital_repository r ON r.external_system_id = p.digital_repository_id WHERE r.digital_repository_type = 'FILESYSTEM'); DELETE FROM arr_dao_package WHERE digital_repository_id IN (SELECT external_system_id FROM arr_digital_repository WHERE digital_repository_type = 'FILESYSTEM');
